mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_exception_event (tracking_id, exception_type, occurred_at, location_unlocode, reason, escalation_flag, response_content, new_estimated_arrival, status, damage_description, photo_url, last_known_location, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{trackingId}, #{exceptionType}, #{occurredAt}, #{locationUnlocode}, #{reason}, #{escalationFlag}, #{responseContent}, #{newEstimatedArrival}, #{status}, #{damageDescription}, #{photoUrl}, #{lastKnownLocation}, #{lastSeenAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tracking_id, exception_type, occurred_at, location_unlocode, reason, escalation_flag, response_content, new_estimated_arrival, status, damage_description, photo_url, last_known_location, last_seen_at FROM tracking_exception_event WHERE tracking_id = #{trackingId} ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking_exception_event SET response_content = #{responseContent}, new_estimated_arrival = #{newEstimatedArrival}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
